name: Psychological Interventions
description: Introduction of psychological intervention: concept, goals, and scope of interventions. Evidence-based interventions and research methods. Historical and theoretical foundations: psychoanalytic, humanistic, behavioral, and cognitive perspectives. Positive psychology interventions (PPIs). Family, group, and community-based interventions. Health and behavior change interventions. Cultural indigenous approaches. Positive technology: digital well-being and tech-based flourishing. Interdisciplinary approaches in psychological interventions. Designing and evaluating intervention programs.
